name: catching_up
description: README and site: what a player sees coming back after a drop. A High Water match on Wickhollow from the hub (I am the Lamplighter, played by the plan bot; Ana's Lookout seat is the caretaker's), held in wave 5 as the Duskmoths come. Then the world as a returning game shows it while it runs the turns it missed: the connection overlay's plate above the console says Catching up with its bar at 62%, and my plate on the party strip says away, since the caretaker still holds my seat until the next build window. Ana's seat is shown present, as a party's would be. The plate is the client track's (scripts/ui/connection_overlay.gd, Main.overlay()); the scenario sets its state, as view_connection_overlay does.

steps.msg: the caretaker plays the Lookout's seat
